div.div: مُوَقَّذَةٌ A she-camel suffering in her dugs from the effect of the rag with which they have been bound to prevent their being sucked, (S, L, K,) by reason of its tightness: (L:) or that has been sucked by her young one without its drawing her milk otherwise than scantily, by reason of the largeness of her udder, in consequence of which she suffers disease, (S, L, K,) and has a tumour (S, L) in her udder. (L.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
